targets.name: Bronze beam moth
targets.concealment: A flat bronze moth shares the aged paint and metalwork of the roof bracket.

targets.name: Brass beetle ornament
targets.concealment: The beetle is integrated into a narrow brass tracery panel near the glasshouse roof.

targets.name: Leaf weather vane
targets.concealment: The thin weather-vane arrow is aligned with window crossbars and blends into brass instrument rods.

targets.name: Three wind cups
targets.concealment: The small bronze cups are one of many round metallic weather fittings against busy window panes.

targets.name: Weather armillary
targets.concealment: Its brass rings overlay vertical glass tubing, slender pipework and foliage.

targets.name: Brass trough lizard
targets.concealment: The long brass creature follows the trough grain and surrounding scrolllike roots and fern stems.

targets.name: Mosaic dragonfly
targets.concealment: The insect is constructed from the same gold mosaic tesserae as the basin reeds.

targets.name: Cloud-shaped mosaic
targets.concealment: The single white cloud shape is one flat motif among similarly shaped mosaic flowers and reeds; separate raindrop motifs remain distractors.

targets.name: Etched watering-can moth
targets.concealment: The small moth is only an etched shape on a mottled copper can, sharing all surrounding reflections.

targets.name: Glossy chestnut
targets.concealment: The glossy brown chestnut is mixed with similar seedpods, wicker, roots and wood chips.

targets.name: Lotus seedpod
targets.concealment: The tan perforated seedpod is mixed with similarly toned seed heads and scattered stems.

targets.name: Owl statue
targets.concealment: The owl has a complete silhouette on the open shelf.

targets.name: Stone tortoise
targets.concealment: The large tortoise sits in the open walkway.

targets.name: Mushroom basket
targets.concealment: The foreground wicker basket and mushroom caps provide a quick discovery.

targets.name: Red-handled shears
targets.concealment: The red handles stand out on the left bench.

review.notes: Rainwater glasshouse composed as a natural dense environment. Fourteen embedded metal, mosaic, specimen and same-texture details; six conspicuous anchors. All contours inspected and Shapely-valid. Actual iPhone difficulty review pending. Revised to user maximum15: selected strongest concealed details; omitted props remain visual distractors. Regular11challenging4easy; every-tenth break3challenging7easy. All target names checked again against enlarged context crops. All fifteen targets audited in source-outline contexts. Retraced complete lizard/legs/tail, beetle limbs, both moths, dragonfly tail/wings, owl feet, tortoise and shears from enlarged affine ROIs. Cloud target explicitly names only the single connected cloud shape; rain drops remain separate decoration.
